descriptions.inProgress: Sirin was more than happy to accommodate, by giving me the pattern to the nicest clothes she has in store. So all I need to do is give this to Juliet?...hmmm... something tells me this might not end up the way I had in plan. Anyway, I better give #bJuliet#k the patterns first.
descriptions.completed: After giving Juliet the pattern, she jumped for joy. That's the good part. Can she really make the clothes based on the pattern, though?
